letter.body: I think that it's a great idea to put a warning on your cigarette packages. I think that it's good to warn people about the risk they're taking. I noticed that the warning is very small. Couldn't you make the warning a little more "eye catching?" I know that you make the warning smaller because you want to sell more but I think that all you have to do is make the warning in a briter color than black. I thank you for your time.
